com.esignal.jstandard.beans.tick

Class DefaultHistoricalTickRequest

  • java.lang.Object
    • com.esignal.jstandard.beans.tick.DefaultHistoricalTickRequest
  • All Implemented Interfaces:
    HistoricalTickRequest, TurnAroundAware
    Direct Known Subclasses:
    IntradayHistoricalTickRequest

    public class DefaultHistoricalTickRequest
extends java.lang.Object
implements HistoricalTickRequest
    This is a default implementation to make a HistoricalTickRequest.PERIOD.TICK request using TickHistoryManager.
    Since:
    01-001-0010
    Author:
    Interactive Data Corporation

      • setServerTurnAround

        public void setServerTurnAround(java.lang.Long serverTurnAround)
        Description copied from interface: HistoricalTickRequest
        This value was introduced for performance reasons. Add this as part of the request in order to optimize the results fetched out of Tick History database. This is very useful in the "drag chart" functionality. Request only the records required to draw the chart. In the next request if user chooses to drag the chart backwards, pass this server turnaround value along with all the other parameters and it will save the database lookup time.

        Remember, this value is not available for the first request.

        Specified by:
        setServerTurnAround in interface HistoricalTickRequest
        Parameters:
        serverTurnAround - Value of server turnaround.
